hero.subheadline: Enter advertising, design, illustration, photography, or fine art
hero.valueProposition: Winning work is featured in the online Gallery and in the 2026 Creative Quarterly Annual, with winners and runners-up receiving certificates and a complimentary eBook.

content.whyJoin:
Creative Quarterly is an international journal focused on promoting the best work in graphic design, illustration, photography, and fine art. The 85th international juried competition accepts commissioned and personal work across advertising, graphic design, illustration, photography, and fine art, with professional and student entries judged separately.

Winning work is featured in the online Gallery immediately after judging is completed and becomes part of the year-end published Annual. Winners are included in the 2026 Creative Quarterly Annual, a softbound book that also lists all runners-up. Winners receive a complimentary eBook version of the Annual and can purchase the printed edition at a discount, while both winners and runners-up receive a complimentary award certificate PDF.

The competition is open to all artists, designers, and photographers at all levels, from professionals and students to amateurs, in all countries. The current quarterly theme is Water, inviting artists to explore how they see water as a symbol of life, destruction, reflection, and self-discovery.
content.whoShouldApply:
This open call is for art directors, designers, illustrators, photographers, and fine artists in all countries, working at professional, student, or amateur level. Creatives with commissioned or self-generated work can enter the Standard category, while those wanting to show work without context can enter the Portfolio category. Artists exploring how they see water can enter the Theme category, where work is judged on how well it portrays the theme.


The competition suits anyone with published or personal work across advertising, graphic design, illustration, photography, or fine art, and it is open to all countries and all experience levels. AI-generated images are not accepted, and professional and student entries are judged separately.

faq.question: What does it cost to enter the Standard category?
faq.answer: Professional entries cost $35 for a single image and $70 for a series of 2-5 related images. Student entries cost $20 for a single image and $35 for a series, for work created for a classroom assignment or thesis.

faq.question: What are the fees for the Theme and Portfolio categories?
faq.answer: Both use a flat fee of $35 for up to 5 images, with $5 charged for each additional image.

faq.question: Can an entrant enter both the Standard and Portfolio categories?
faq.answer: Yes. With Standard entries there are single and series entries, and a series must have a single focus. The Portfolio category accepts individual pieces without regard to their use.

faq.question: What is the current Theme category about?
faq.answer: The current quarterly theme is Water, exploring how artists see water as a symbol of life, destruction, reflection, and self-discovery. Work is judged on how well it portrays the theme.

faq.question: What do winners receive?
faq.answer: Winning work is featured in the online Gallery and in the 2026 Creative Quarterly Annual, which also lists runners-up. Winners receive a complimentary eBook version and can purchase the printed Annual at a discount, and winners and runners-up receive a complimentary award certificate PDF.

faq.question: Are AI-generated images accepted?
faq.answer: No. AI-generated images are not accepted, and professional and student entries are judged separately.

faq.question: How is the work judged?
faq.answer: The jury selects specific images from each entrant that best represent their work, whether from a series, theme, or portfolio, and these selections are featured in the year-end printed Annual.

submissionGuide.detail: Select the Standard category for commissioned or self-generated work, the Theme category for up to five images exemplifying the current theme of Water, or the Portfolio category for individual pieces without regard to their use.
For Standard entries, submit a single image or a related series of 2-5 images. For Theme and Portfolio entries, submit up to five images at a flat fee, with $5 for each additional image.
Fees are $35 single or $70 series for professionals, $20 single or $35 series for students, and $35 for up to 5 images in the Theme or Portfolio categories.
Enter through the Secure Awards platform linked on the Call for Entries 85 page, create or log in to an account, and follow the upload and payment steps.
Winning work is featured in the online Gallery immediately after judging is completed, with winners showcased in the 2026 Creative Quarterly Annual.
